audio_description:
The red Galbadia Garden towers over the forest.
Seifer stands aboard it, coat marked with red crosses, gazing ahead.
The Garden sweeps over the mountains, trailing turquoise energy.

context.scene_title: Seifer aboard the mobile Galbadia Garden — the Sorceress's knight rides the pursuing Garden (Disc 2).
locations: Atop/aboard the red Galbadia Garden as it flies over forested mountains, trailing turquoise energy

characters.name: Seifer Almasy
characters.recognition: Blond, slicked-back hair, hard-jawed scowl, grey-white trench coat marked with red crosses (the Cross of Saint); standing against the red Garden.

context.summary: The red Galbadia Garden towers over the forest; Seifer stands aboard it, coat marked with red crosses, gazing ahead as the Garden sweeps over the mountains trailing a ribbon of turquoise energy — the Sorceress's knight leading the pursuit of Balamb Garden.
context.context_note: High confidence: Seifer (identified by his crossed coat and features) aboard the mobile Galbadia Garden.
